product.title: Balloon Ride over Catalonia with optional Pick-up from Barcelona

description.text: Soar above the sublime landscape of Catalonia near Barcelona on this early-morning hot-air balloon excursion. Marvel at beautiful landmarks like Montserrat and the Pyrenees Mountains as you climb to heights of up to 3,000 feet (900 meters) during your 1- to 1.5-hour flight. Stops include Montserrat, Pyrenees, Montseny. Then head back down to earth for brunch with sparkling wine. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
